title: Nori the Little Helicopter and the Moonlight Mail
description: A little turquoise helicopter and her lavender glider friend deliver moonlight postcards across a peaceful valley, then settle to sleep at their hilltop post office under the moon.

Nori.role: Main character; a small friendly civilian helicopter
Nori.color: Soft ocean turquoise with ivory landing skids, charcoal-gray rotors, and one golden-yellow stripe on the tail fin
Nori.bodyShape: Compact rounded egg-shaped fuselage with a short tail boom, exactly two main rotor blades, a small two-blade tail rotor, and two short ivory skids; no arms, hands, legs, numbers, or lettering
Nori.face: Two large dark-brown eyes inside the upper front windshield and a small curved smile on the nose below the windshield
Nori.accessories: Small cream fabric mail pouch on the right side with a tiny embroidered golden crescent moon; already worn from page 3 onward

Sora.role: Supporting character; a tiny lavender delivery glider who first appears on page 4
Sora.color: Soft pastel lavender with cream wingtip stripes and a pale-yellow star near the base of the vertical tail
Sora.bodyShape: Small rounded unpowered glider about half Nori's body length, with two long curved wings, one vertical fin, two horizontal stabilizers, one tiny cream wheel, and one small rear skid; no engine, rotor, propeller, arms, or hands
Sora.face: Two large warm hazel-brown eyes inside a single rounded canopy and a soft smile on the nose
Sora.accessories: None beyond the fixed yellow tail star and cream wingtip stripes

settingBible.Moonlight Valley: A peaceful countryside valley with a hilltop post office, a lavender farmhouse, a winding silver stream, and a cozy stone cottage under a soft evening-to-moonlight sky
settingBible.Hilltop Post Office: A small honey-wood post office with a burnt-orange roof, pale-blue door, amber porch lantern, circular stone helipad, wicker postcard basket, and an open-front wooden glider nook with a powder-blue cushion
settingBible.visualStyle: Warm polished 3D children's illustration, soft rounded aircraft, golden evening fading to moonlit blue, one scene per page, and no readable text on story pages

continuityRules: Nori keeps turquoise body, ivory skids, two-blade rotors, yellow tail stripe, and cream mail pouch already worn from page 3.
Sora stays a smaller lavender glider with cream wingtip stripes and a yellow tail star, and first appears on page 4.
Postcards fill the pouch on page 5, are delivered on pages 8 and 10, and the pouch is empty from page 11 onward.
Pages 14–15 keep Nori on the helipad and Sora in the glider nook at the same hilltop post office.
No rescue, danger, storm, lettering, logos, or extra named characters.
Every illustration is one continuous scene with no panels, collage, grid, text, badge, logo, or readable words on story-page artwork.

pages.text: In a peaceful valley surrounded by gentle green hills, a little turquoise helicopter named Nori loved flying through the soft evening sky.
pages.illustrationScene: Turquoise helicopter Nori hovers happily above a cozy hillside village in warm late-afternoon sunlight.

pages.text: Every evening, Nori rested on a small hilltop helipad beside a cheerful little post office with a bright orange roof.
pages.illustrationScene: Nori rests alone on the circular hilltop helipad beside the wooden post office with a bright orange roof.

pages.text: One golden evening, Nori wore her cream mail pouch and noticed a little basket of moonlight postcards waiting beside the post office door.
pages.illustrationScene: Nori already wearing her cream mail pouch looks curiously at a wicker basket of moonlight postcards by the post office door.
pages.continuityNotes: Nori alone; Sora absent. Nori already wears the cream mail pouch.

pages.text: Her friend Sora, a tiny lavender delivery glider, said the postcards were for friends across the valley.
pages.illustrationScene: Lavender glider Sora first appears beside Nori near the postcard basket as the sky turns peach and lavender.
pages.continuityNotes: Nori and Sora; cream pouch continuity. Nori already wears the cream mail pouch.

pages.text: Together they carefully tucked the little postcards into Nori's snug delivery pouch.
pages.illustrationScene: Nori and Sora tuck the postcards into Nori's already-worn cream side pouch beside the post office.
pages.continuityNotes: Nori and Sora; cream pouch continuity. Nori already wears the cream mail pouch.

pages.text: The two friends lifted into the evening sky, floating past sleepy clouds that glowed pink and gold.
pages.illustrationScene: Nori hovers steadily with Sora gliding alongside above the valley under soft pink and gold clouds.
pages.timeOfDay: late sunset pink and gold clouds
pages.continuityNotes: Nori and Sora; cream pouch continuity. Nori already wears the cream mail pouch.

pages.text: Their first stop was a little farmhouse, where a warm window glimmered among rows of lavender flowers.
pages.illustrationScene: Nori and Sora approach a cream farmhouse with a blue roof, glowing window, lavender rows, and a wooden mailbox.
pages.continuityNotes: Nori and Sora; cream pouch continuity. Nori already wears the cream mail pouch.

pages.text: Nori gently placed one moonlight postcard into the farmhouse mailbox, but Sora still circled slowly through the quiet air.
pages.illustrationScene: Nori hovers low to place one postcard in the farmhouse mailbox while Sora glides in a gentle arc overhead.
pages.continuityNotes: Nori and Sora; cream pouch continuity. Nori already wears the cream mail pouch.

pages.text: Farther along the valley, a soft evening breeze carried the friends above a silver stream where tiny fireflies twinkled.
pages.illustrationScene: Nori and Sora fly over a winding silver stream with fireflies among the reeds under deepening twilight.
pages.continuityNotes: Nori and Sora; cream pouch continuity. Nori already wears the cream mail pouch.

pages.text: At a cozy cottage beside the stream, Sora guided Nori toward another little mailbox glowing beneath a golden porch lantern.
pages.illustrationScene: Sora guides Nori toward a stone cottage mailbox glowing beneath a golden porch lantern by the stream.
pages.continuityNotes: Nori and Sora; cream pouch continuity. Nori already wears the cream mail pouch.

pages.text: With the last postcard delivered, Nori looked up and saw the first bright stars sparkling above the peaceful valley.
pages.illustrationScene: Nori hovers beside the cottage mailbox with an empty delivery pouch as first stars sparkle above the valley.
pages.continuityNotes: Nori and Sora; cream pouch continuity. Nori already wears the cream mail pouch. Pouch empty after last delivery.

pages.text: The whole valley was getting ready for sleep as they began their gentle journey home together beneath the rising moon.
pages.illustrationScene: Nori and Sora fly home toward the distant hilltop under a large soft-glowing crescent moon.
pages.continuityNotes: Nori and Sora; cream pouch continuity. Nori already wears the cream mail pouch. Pouch empty after last delivery.

pages.text: A cool nighttime breeze brushed Nori's rotor, and Sora gave a sleepy little yawn as the familiar orange roof came into view.
pages.illustrationScene: Nori flies slowly beside sleepy Sora as the familiar orange post-office roof and amber helipad lights come into view.
pages.timeOfDay: moonlit approach to the post office
pages.continuityNotes: Nori and Sora; cream pouch continuity. Nori already wears the cream mail pouch. Pouch empty after last delivery.

pages.text: Back at the hilltop, Nori settled onto the cozy helipad while Sora rested in a little sheltered glider nook beside the post office.
pages.illustrationScene: Nori settles on the circular helipad with rotor slowing while Sora rests in the open-front glider nook with a blue cushion.
pages.timeOfDay: peaceful late night at the hilltop
pages.continuityNotes: Nori and Sora; cream pouch continuity. Nori already wears the cream mail pouch. Pouch empty after last delivery. Final rest: Nori on helipad, Sora in glider nook; eyes closed on page 15.

pages.text: Beneath the silver moon and a sky full of gentle stars, Nori and Sora closed their sleepy eyes and drifted peacefully to sleep.
pages.illustrationScene: Nori sleeps on the helipad and Sora sleeps in the nearby glider nook, both with eyes fully closed under moonlight.
pages.continuityNotes: Nori and Sora; cream pouch continuity. Nori already wears the cream mail pouch. Pouch empty after last delivery. Final rest: Nori on helipad, Sora in glider nook; eyes closed on page 15.
